projects.title: AURA - 12-DOF Humanoid Robot
projects.tagline: Upper-Body Bipedal Humanoid with Dual-Brain Distributed Edge AI & Real-Time Motor Actuation
projects.description: AURA is a 12-degree-of-freedom (12-DOF) humanoid robot designed and engineered with an intelligent split architecture. The upper body (arms, torso, and head) is fully constructed, and precision standing-pose servo calibration has been successfully executed across all 12 joint axes.
bullets: Split-Brain Edge Architecture: Jetson Nano handles high-level computer vision, real-time speech processing, and autonomous behavioral state machines.
Low-Latency Joint Control: ESP32 reads IMU sensor orientation data and orchestrates precise multi-servo kinematics over I2C via PCA9685 12-bit PWM drivers.
Integrated Hardware Suite: Wide-angle camera, noise-canceling microphone, speaker, diagnostic OLED display, and 6-axis gyroscope IMU.
Mechanical Construction: Upper body (torso pitch/yaw, head pan/tilt, 4-DOF dual arms) assembled and calibrated to stable standing zero-pose.

projects.title: SMART GATE PASS MANAGEMENT SYSTEM
projects.tagline: Firebase-Powered College Gate Pass Management with Role-Based OTP & Real-Time QR Verification
projects.description: Smart Gate Pass Management System is a full-stack college management application designed to digitize and secure the student gate-pass process. It replaces traditional paper-based gate passes with a digital workflow featuring real-time approvals, phone OTP authentication, QR code verification, and security tracking.
bullets: Role-Based Authentication: Separate secure portals and permissions for Admin, HOD, Student, and Campus Security.
Real-Time Phone OTP Login: Integrated Firebase Phone Authentication for instant identity verification of students and HODs.
Digital Approval & QR Verification: Students submit digital requests; HOD verifies and approves; dynamic tamper-proof QR code is generated for security scanning at the exit gate.
Security Tracking & Audit Dashboard: Real-time logging of student exits, returns, QR scan activity, with CSV export and admin analytics.

architecture_notes.authentication: Firebase Phone Authentication (OTP) & Role-Based Access Control
architecture_notes.file_storage: Firebase Storage (Student Profile Photos & Digital Pass Media)
architecture_notes.security: Firestore Security Rules, Storage Rules, Firebase App Check
architecture_notes.future_scope: Advanced analytics, automated SMS notifications, and existing college ERP integration

projects.title: AI SMART ATTENDANCE & COLLEGE ERP SYSTEM
projects.tagline: AI-Powered Face Recognition for Automated Classroom Attendance & Integrated Campus Management
projects.description: AI Smart Attendance & College ERP Management System is an intelligent educational platform designed to automate classroom attendance using AI-based face recognition. It combines real-time attendance tracking with college administration, timetable management, leave applications, and student performance monitoring in one centralized system.
bullets: AI Face Recognition: Automates theory classroom attendance via camera-based facial detection and embeddings matching.
Smart Board Integration: Optimized real-time attendance visual dashboard for classroom smart boards and faculty devices.
Timetable & Substitution Engine: Restricts attendance access strictly to scheduled faculty or approved substitutes.
Complete ERP Workflow: Student & faculty profiles, leave management, attendance dispute corrections, and audit logging.

architecture_notes.database: PostgreSQL with Session Management via Redis
architecture_notes.security: JWT, Argon2 / bcrypt password hashing, encrypted biometric vectors
architecture_notes.devops: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI/CD
architecture_notes.future_scope: Enhanced liveness anti-spoofing detection, multi-campus scalability, and ERP syncing
